findings.detail: The earlier native_capabilities helper describes its old company path; later native return execution adds memory/tax/reporting but does not establish arbitrary module imports.
NativeReturnBookReference and SharedLeaseBook have different exact state/account registries. A field union is not a supported native state.
Measurements, diagnostic effects, proposals, report-only results and database commit are distinct capabilities.
Existing persistence hard-codes the old Engine in create_run and replay. Its durability evidence cannot transfer automatically to newer pure proposal methods.
SectorCompany explicitly maps old component entity/currency labels under fixed findings. This permitted mapping does not license arbitrary renamed contexts.

No checked common caller envelope selects a pinned capability and preserves the complete native status/result across the current adapters. Begin with this interface; shared-state composition remains a later obligation.
